title: Set as Default on a list view leaves two default views when the previous default is a package-shipped view (its unset PUT is refused 403, the new default still lands)
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33096 · records-forms.saved-view-management · acceptance[1] / negative[2]

**Found:** QA run of `touched:ee9ad834` at objectstack main `8e3d4a54` (18.4.0 round 2, part B, browser slice). Reproduced twice, on fresh loads; the second time with a view created over the API.

## Repro
1. Stock showcase, `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, sign in as admin.
2. Create a published list view on `showcase_task`: either Create View + Publish in the console, or
   `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_x {name, object:'showcase_task', viewKind:'list', label, config:{type:'grid', columns:['title'], data:{provider:'object', object:'showcase_task'}}}` → 200.
3. Console → Tasks → view switcher → Manage views → **Set as Default** on the new view (`data-testid=manage-views-default-<view>`).
4. Network:
   - `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` carries the shipped All Tasks view with `isDefault:false` and no `?package=`. It is refused 403 (not overridable; the refusal names `com.example.showcase.custom`).
   - Then `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_x` with `isDefault:true` → 200.
   - The console toasts "Failed to save …".
5. Reload → Manage views shows DEFAULT on both views, and `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_task` returns both with `isDefault`. The bare `/showcase_task` route now opens the new view.

**Expected:** the previous default is unset (written into the customization pair), or the whole set-default is refused before anything is written.
**Actual:** there are two defaults.

## Mechanism (read from source at 8e3d4a54)
- `setDefaultViewPatches` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts:482`) emits `{isDefault:false}` for the shipped default.
- `updateView` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:6837`) saves that patch package-less through `client.meta.saveItem('view', name, merged)`. ADR-0146 D11 refuses a package-less write to an item a read-only package ships.
- The handler still applies the new default's patch.

The same root likely affects any console row-state write (`isPinned`, `sortOrder`, rename) aimed at a shipped view.

## Fix direction
Route a shipped view's row-state write into the customization pair (`?package=<pair>`). Or plan the whole set-default first and refuse it as a unit.

**Severity:** a visible inconsistency (two DEFAULT badges, and the default route moves). No data loss.
